note: Hand-written engine scenarios for the keyed card questions in Cody's quizzes and the official test (plan section 7, stage 1). Derived from eval questions: never used in prompts, retrieval or training. Measures the engine only.

checks.what: Mox Inciters (seat 1) targets Misty, the only rival Unit; on seat 0's next turn, is Misty offered an attack?
Afterparty adjusts the D4 by KEEP (no change) with Gigs 2 and 5: is a card drawn?
Carnage with two 8+ Gigs: what is paid.

reading.why: The key is about the card's cost as a characteristic. The engine shows only what was paid (6 printed, 4 paid with two 8+ Gigs); no admitted effect reads a Program's cost while it is played, so no scenario can separate the two.

checks.what: Sasha (power 0) goes solo and declares an attack with no rival Units: does the attack go at the Gig area?

patterns: attacks the gig area of seat 1

checks.what: Voodoo Boy is played, then Pyramid Song: is Voodoo Boy offered an attack?

On the rival's turn, a Unit with The Relic is defeated in a fight and The Relic plays Rogue from the trash: is Rogue's Quick ability offered to seat 0 afterwards? The React step has already closed when Rogue arrives; the sealed-event part of the question is not modelled.
Sketchy Ripper attacks with a Gear among the top 3: may the search finish without taking a card?
Unlikely Bond with no rival Units: is the friendly Unit bottom-decked anyway?

A Unit played this turn has Adrenaline from Adrenaline Converter while the rival has 2 more Gigs; after a steal evens the Gigs, is it still offered an attack? Animals Wrecker is replaced by Rockn' Rockerboy (also vanilla): Wrecker needs RED 3 and the Converter YELLOW 4, more RAM than 3 Legends give, so the quiz's pair is not a legal deck.
Les Elemens on a gone-solo V wearing Dying Night: does V leave the game while the Gear goes to the deck?
Calling a face-down Adam Smasher, Ender of Legends: is the rival Unit defeated (his Play effect)?

patterns: ^adam-smasher-ender-of-legends \[p0-c\d+\] seat 0: face-down Legend -> face up in LEGENDS

checks.what: Wild in the Streets with no spent Unit anywhere: is it offered?
A Ganger Unit wins by 3+ after Appetite for Destruction and steals: does Evelyn Parker (face up; when a friendly CORPO or GANGER Unit steals) ready an Eddie?

patterns: ^seat 0 gig p1-D6: none -> D6=3 in GIGS$

checks.what: A non-Arasaka Unit wearing Satori attacks with Yorinobu, Embracing Destruction face up (the first ARASAKA Unit attack each turn draws 1): is a card drawn? The control check runs the same with an Arasaka Unit.
Control for cody-quiz-36: an Arasaka Unit (Minotaur) attacks with the same Legend; the draw must happen.
Goro, Hands Unclean face up and spent with 5 Eddies: is Go Solo offered?
The rival's Live with the Aftermath defeats Yorinobu, Steel Dragon (an Arasaka Unit): does its owner draw 1?
The rival attacks with an empty hand: is Augmented Negotiators offered as a Blocker?

Safety Override, then a friendly Unit already on the field loses a fight: is the opposing rival Unit defeated? Read as: the effect applies to Units already on the field. Playing it opens no target choice.
Zetatech Berserk with two face-up Legends: what is paid.

reading.why: Same as cody-quiz-06: the key is about the Gear's cost as a characteristic; the engine shows only what was paid (6 printed, 4 paid with two face-up Legends).
